Simulation of steady-state (achieved via transient run to convergence) two-phase oil-water flow in a horizontal pipe using OpenFOAM-v2206.
Solver: twoPhaseEulerFoam (transient PIMPLE algorithm), run until flow variables reach a time-invariant regime.
Phases: water as the continuous phase, oil as the dispersed phase (Eulerian-Eulerian, no particles).
Geometry: horizontal cylindrical pipe, diameter 0.1 m, length 1.0 m, generated with blockMesh (O-grid or hex-decomposed mesh, approximately 50 cells radial, 50 cells circumferential, 100 cells axial; adjust to keep y+ reasonable for a turbulent RAS/LES setup).
Boundary conditions for U (velocity): inlet is a fixed uniform mixture velocity of 1.0 m/s in the streamwise (x) direction (value chosen by the analyst as a typical tutorial scale; the user did not specify a numeric value); walls use noSlip; outlet uses zeroGradient; front/back symmetry planes if a sector mesh is used.
Boundary conditions for p (kinematic pressure): inlet zeroGradient, outlet fixedValue uniform 0, walls zeroGradient.
Boundary conditions for alpha.water: inlet fixedValue uniform 0.3, walls zeroGradient, outlet zeroGradient (explicitly corrected from the erroneous fixedValue 0.3 in the original draft).
Boundary conditions for turbulent fields (k, epsilon or omega as selected in turbulenceProperties): inlet fixedValue with reasonable turbulence intensity (e.g. 5% I, 7% L), walls appropriate wall functions or zeroGradient, outlet zeroGradient.
constant/transportProperties: two-phase block for water (rho 1000 kg/m3, nu ~1e-6 m2/s) and oil (rho ~850 kg/m3, nu ~1e-4 m2/s, e.g. light mineral oil); set viscosityModel and phase interaction models (drag, lift) to sensible tutorial defaults.
constant/turbulenceProperties: RAS model k-epsilon (or k-omega SST) applied to the mixture or per-phase as required by twoPhaseEulerFoam in v2206; select the model that is fully supported in this release.
system/fvSchemes: transient scheme backward, div schemes limitedLinear or upwind for alpha and momentum, laplacian Gauss linear, grad/interpolation schemes consistent with v2206 defaults; PIMPLE settings with nOuterCorrectors 1, nCorrectors 2-3, adjustTimeStep yes, maxDeltaT chosen so Courant number stays below 1 for the dispersed phase.
system/fvSolution: PIMPLE algorithm, relaxed solvers for p, U, alpha; GAMG or PCG+GAMG for pressure, smoothSolver for momentum and alpha; set appropriate rel factors for convergence to steady state.
system/control: startTime 0, endTime large enough to guarantee convergence (e.g. 10-50 s depending on time step), writeControl adjustable with a window to inspect convergence; writeInterval chosen to capture the transient approach.
All dictionaries must be syntactically valid for OpenFOAM-v2206 (use the correct boundary patch naming: inlet, outlet, wall or pipe, and axis/centerline if O-grid).
The user explicitly delegated geometry dimensions and the inlet velocity magnitude to the analyst; these are not user-specified values and must be labeled as analyst assumptions in any accompanying notes.
